# FreeVideoFX

> > Free video effects, templates, transitions, and plugins for Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, and DaVinci Resolve

FreeVideoFX is a community platform for graphics designers and content creators offering free downloads of Videohive templates, motion graphics assets, video editing tools, and filmmaking courses. The site features resources from GFXInspire and other creators, with templates compatible across major video editing software including Adobe Creative Suite, Final Cut Pro X, and DaVinci Resolve.

## Key Topics

- Adobe After Effects
- Adobe Premiere Pro
- Final Cut Pro
- DaVinci Resolve
- Videohive templates
- Motion graphics
- Video transitions
- Logo animation
- Video effects
- Light leaks
- Color grading
- MOGRT templates
- Kinetic text
- GFXInspire
- Free video editing assets
